articles.title: Another Bitcoin infrastructure exploit hits, this time draining Lightning payment servers
articles.snippet: BTCPay told users running LND to update immediately or take servers offline after attackers stole credentials that can control Lightning wallets and move funds.

articles.title: Coldcard exploit pushes July losses to $247M as second-worst month of 2026
articles.snippet: The Coldcard exploit, which caused more than $100 million in losses, helped push July crypto thefts to $247 million, making it the second-worst month of 2026.

articles.title: Bitget explores licensed crypto presence in Bhutan
articles.snippet: Crypto exchange Bitget has signed an agreement with Gelephu Mindfulness City Authority to pursue a regulated local presence.

articles.title: Bitcoin Red Team Says AI Is Finding Critical Exploits Across Core Projects
articles.snippet: A volunteer security effort says it has scanned 150 Bitcoin repositories, disclosed more than a dozen vulnerabilities, and is building an open-source AI platform to automate software security reviews.

articles.title: Robinhood Crypto Chief Explains Why There Are 'Two Wolves' Inside Robinhood Chain
articles.snippet: “We want to show customers that we care about what they care about," Robinhood head of crypto Johann Kerbrat told Decrypt.
